items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I run into Al Cohn who wants to know if I know a song, 'It's Wonderful.'

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Right. But by this time, Stuff had come back to New York, and he came to the club and brought me a copy of this tune that he supposedly had written. His name is on it now. It later turned out that him and somebody else wrote it, and then -- I think Robins published it -- but I introduced it at the Onyx Club. And it became quite a favorite. And, of course, a few years later, I run into Al Cohn who wants to know if I know a song, 'It's Wonderful.' And he hummed a few bars. I said, 'Yeah, I introduced it in 1938.'…
